body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics unveiled its new 12.1-inch notebook pc 'S-210' during KES 2008, which is powered by Intel Centrino 2. Weighing around 1kg, the S-210 is equipped with Core 2 Duo 2.43Ghz processor and 4GB of memory. No words on specification and pricing yet.
